## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests/typechecks pass; unrun checks are explained below.

- [ ] No secrets, private media links, or personal/user data are included.
- [ ] New dependencies/assets have compatible licenses and preserved notices.
- [ ] Commits are signed off under the DCO (`git commit -s`).
